channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new residency - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Ars Biologica ArtXScience Residency 2027-2028 (Ars Electronica x Ceske Budejovice ECoC 2028)
    https://ars.electronica.art/export/en/ecoc2028-ars-biologica-art-science-residency/
    Ars Electronica and Ceske Budejovice - European Capital of Culture 2028 · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · EUR 24,000 total package per winner: EUR 6,000 artist fee, up to EUR 15,000 production budget, and up to EUR 3,000 for travel, accommodation and subsistence, plus a separate budget covering one month of housing in Ceske Budejovice. Two positions available. Free to apply.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new residency - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Studio ALTA Residence 2027: four residency open calls (Prague)
    https://www.altart.cz/rezidence-2027/
    Studio ALTA · deadline 10 Sep 2026 · Residency fees paid to participants: Research House CZK 12,000 per project; Rest House CZK 6,000 per person; House in the Neighborhood CZK 30,000 per project; House of Sweat CZK 15,000 per project. All include workspace at Studio ALTA; the two production residencies add dramaturgic, production, technical and PR support. Free to apply.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new residencies - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Instituto Sacatar: Sacatar Fellowship 2027 (Bahia, Brazil)
    https://sacatar.org/en/fellowships/
    Instituto Sacatar · deadline Closed 28 Aug 2026 · Fully hosted residency: private bedroom with attached bathroom, three meals a day (except Saturday evenings, Sundays and Brazilian holidays), an individual studio suited to the discipline, weekly laundry, logistical support and airport transfer from Salvador. NO STIPEND, no airfare and no materials budget. USD 25 application fee. One French artist may additionally receive airfare and a stipend through Villa Fatumbi.
  • Art Explora x Cite internationale des arts Residency Programme, 2027 Sessions
    https://www.citeinternationaledesarts.fr/en/programme-de-residence/art-explora-x-cite-internationale-des-arts/
    Art Explora Foundation with the Cite internationale des arts · deadline 06 Nov 2026 · Monthly living grant of EUR 1,000, production grant of up to EUR 3,000, a round-trip travel grant, and a fully equipped studio-apartment of roughly 50 sqm. For collectives and duos the living grant (up to EUR 2,000) and the production grant (up to EUR 3,000) are shared between members. Access to production facilities and local networks. No application fee.
  • Good Life Residents Program: AI and Finance
    https://rooseveltinstitute.org/careers/good-life-resident-program/
    Roosevelt Institute, in partnership with Data & Society · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 3,000 stipend, plus travel and accommodation for the culminating event if needed. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new residency - week of 13 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Research Trip to Switzerland
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/research-trip-to-switzerland/
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline Rolling / undated · Accommodation, travel costs, and daily allowances covered, plus a local coach (a cultural professional from the Swiss artistic field) to facilitate networking and exchange. Applicants with childcare responsibilities can request up to CHF 1,000 per month toward childcare or children's travel expenses. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 5 new residencies - week of 06 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Chornobyl40: Open Call 2026 (Virtual Residency & International Exhibition)
    https://forms.gle/5btrxy7LwfY8QyFW6
    Chornobyl40 (gate22 / European Institute of Chornobyl consortium) · deadline Closed 12 Jul 2026 · Residency is free to attend. For the 20 projects selected for production: EUR 500 grant for fully digital works or EUR 1,000 grant for installations requiring physical materials, plus inclusion in the international exhibition. Travel, accommodation, and transport are not covered. No application fee.
  • New Emergence Art Prize 2026
    https://www.newemergenceart.com/apply
    New Emergence Art · deadline Closed 03 Aug 2026 · Prize fund worth over GBP 5,000 across nine awards, including a GBP 1,000 Grand Prize cash award, a two-week NG Art Creative Residency in Provence, France (worth EUR 2,000), a GBP 300 Founder's Prize cash award, and materials or subscription awards from Staedtler UK, Rosemary & Co, GreatArt, Michael Harding, and The Art Ladder. NOTE: there is a paid entry fee.
  • Akademie Schloss Solitude: Web Residencies No. 22 - Ignore All Previous Instructions
    https://application.akademie-solitude.de/fellowship-information/web-residencies
    Akademie Schloss Solitude · deadline Closed 07 Aug 2026 · EUR 1,200 grant for a four-week online residency, plus a microsite to develop and publish the project, and support from a web/UX designer and a programmer in a supportive capacity.
  • Padimai: OOPS Onchain Artist Residency 2026
    https://padimai.net/onchain-artist-residency/
    Padimai Art and Tech Studio · deadline Closed 15 Aug 2026 · SGD 15,000 honorarium per artist plus an additional SGD 5,000 per artist for documentation (audio, video, photography). Five practitioners selected. No application fee.
  • Game Design Emerging Talents: She Got Game
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/game-design-emerging-talents-she-got-game-3/
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · CHF 3,000 toward the production of a prototype or demo version, plus individual coaching and community access; potential access to international trade fairs. When attending trade fairs, applicants with childcare responsibilities can request up to CHF 250 per week for childcare or children's travel expenses. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 2 new residencies - week of 29 Jun 2026
item.description:
• TED & POSCA Global Artist Residency 2026: Visible Mending
    https://fineacts.co/ted-posca-residency
    TED & POSCA (curated by Fine Acts) · deadline Closed 31 Jul 2026 · Each selected artist receives a total of USD 15,000 (covering artist fees, production costs/community activation, and documentation), plus a production budget and tools from POSCA, creative direction and storytelling support, and visibility through TED and Fine Acts' global platforms.
  • CASA PIP Residency for Filmmakers
    https://casapip.com/apply
    CASA PIP · deadline Closed 31 Jul 2026 · Free residency (no cost to attend), offering time, space, and peace to work on a project or an early idea. A EUR 35 application fee applies.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 4 new residencies - week of 15 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Revitalizing Rituals 2026 Open Call
    https://homofaber.hu/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Artist-Open-Call-FINAL-in-the-RR-form.pdf
    Homo Faber Alapítvány (Homo Faber Foundation) · deadline Closed 19 Jul 2026 · EUR 6,000 gross artist fee and production budget; international travel and per diems covered; on-site accommodation provided. No application fee.
  • Lee Ufan Arles: Prix Art & Environnement 2026 (Residency + Exhibition Prize)
    https://en.leeufan-arles.org/evenements/art-environment-prize
    Lee Ufan Arles and Maison Guerlain · deadline Closed 31 Jul 2026 · Funded residency (production space + accommodation) in Arles. No cash prize amount specified. No application fee.
  • AdK / EMS Berlin-Stockholm Bilateral Residency Program 2026-27
    https://nc.adk.de/index.php/apps/forms/s/HD2nxbzqwgeMHWN6xHg9bQrA
    Studio für Elektroakustische Musik, Akademie der Künste (Berlin) and Elektronmusikstudion EMS (Stockholm) · deadline Closed 31 Jul 2026 · Travel and accommodation costs for stays in Berlin and Stockholm covered; fees paid for presentation at KONTAKTE Festival 2027 (Berlin) and for presentation in Stockholm. Amount not publicly stated. No application fee.
  • OIF: Support for Artist Mobility and Circulation of Cultural Goods 2026 (Francophonie)
    https://appelsaprojets.francophonie.org/fr/applications/soutien-a-la-circulation-des-biens-et-mobilite-des-artistes
    Organisation internationale de la Francophonie (OIF) · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Up to EUR 5,000 for artist mobility (travel, accommodation, visas, logistics). Up to EUR 2,500 for circulation of cultural goods (excess baggage, freight, customs). Both can be combined. No application fee.
